name: UltiMaker (Ultimaker B.V.)
summary: Dutch desktop and professional FDM printer maker that also formulates and sells its own verified material range (Tough PLA, CPE/CPE+, Nylon, PC, TPU 95A, PVA, PP and more). Headquartered in Utrecht since 2019; the 2022 merger with MakerBot brought that brand in-house, leaving NPM Capital with 53.5% and Stratasys with 46.5%. Runs an open materials marketplace with third-party partners such as Tectonic-3D on top of its own catalog.

oem_relationships.notes: MakerBot merged with Ultimaker in 2022 and is now a brand UltiMaker owns and operates (MakerBot Sketch / Sketch Sprint printers sell alongside the UltiMaker S, Factor and Method series). This is in-house brand ownership, not third-party white-labelling; 'rebrands' is the nearest available enum value. Not present in research/verified-oem-relationships.md.

Tectonic-3D high-performance filaments are integrated into the UltiMaker materials marketplace. Confirmed as a partnership and marketplace listing, explicitly NOT a manufacture-for relationship — UltiMaker does not make these and Tectonic-3D does not make UltiMaker's own line. 'joint-venture' is the nearest available enum value. Not present in research/verified-oem-relationships.md.

Stratasys holds a 46.5% minority stake in Ultimaker B.V. post-MakerBot merger (NPM Capital holds 53.5%). Ownership stake, not a manufacturing relationship; recorded here because it links UltiMaker into the wider Stratasys professional-AM ecosystem. Not present in research/verified-oem-relationships.md.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker PLA
product_lines.notes: Generic PLA; the MakerBot Sketch / Replicator+ PLA is the same chemistry repackaged.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker Tough PLA
product_lines.notes: Impact-modified PLA positioned against ABS; the Sketch-series 'Tough' filament is the same chemistry.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker ABS
product_lines.notes: Generic ABS.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker ABS-R (Method)
product_lines.notes: Recycled/reground ABS; standard ABS chemistry. RapidRinse is its companion soluble support, not a base polymer.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker ABS Carbon Fiber (Method)
product_lines.notes: ABS + chopped carbon fiber. This catalog has abs-gf but no abs-cf id, so the line is left unmapped.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker ASA
product_lines.notes: Generic ASA.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker PETG (Method)
product_lines.notes: Generic PETG in the Method series.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker CPE
product_lines.notes: 'Co-polyester': TDS gives 1.27 g/cm3, ~38 MPa XY tensile and Shore 76D - PETG/PCTG-class glycol-modified copolyester, not a distinct polymer.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker CPE+
product_lines.notes: Higher-temperature, higher-strength grade of the same co-polyester family as CPE. No TDS figures gathered this pass, so left unmapped rather than assumed identical to petg.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker PP
product_lines.notes: Generic polypropylene.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker Nylon
product_lines.notes: Generic polyamide; community and TDS references point at the 12-family but UltiMaker does not disclose the PA6/PA12 split, so mapped to base pa.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker Nylon 12 CF (Method)
product_lines.notes: PA12 + chopped carbon fiber.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker PC
product_lines.notes: Generic polycarbonate.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker PC-ABS (Method)
product_lines.notes: Polycarbonate/ABS blend.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker TPU 95A
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A TPU.

product_lines.name: Factor series PPS Carbon Fiber
product_lines.notes: Polyphenylene sulfide + carbon fiber, the industrial Factor/S-series high-temperature composite.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker PVA
product_lines.notes: Water-soluble polyvinyl alcohol support.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker Breakaway (Method)
product_lines.notes: Mechanically-removed styrenic-blend support, not water-soluble - distinct chemistry from PVA and no matching id.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker SR-30 / RapidRinse (Method)
product_lines.notes: Soluble supports for ABS-family builds; proprietary chemistry, no matching id.

product_lines.name: UltiMaker Cleaning Filament
product_lines.notes: Purge/cleaning compound, not a build material.

additional_notes: Materials are segmented by printer tier: Factor series (certified high-performance/industrial), S series (broadest range, 300+ materials through the open marketplace) and Method series (polymers, composites and metals for engineering use). Multi-continent manufacturing — Netherlands (primary), US assembly lines and a Singapore site opened in 2018 serving APAC/China — is confirmed for printer hardware; it is unverified whether filament is extruded at all three or only a subset, so manufacturing_countries may overstate the filament footprint. UltiMaker sells printer-specific build plates and glass beds as accessories for its own hardware, which is standard OEM practice, but no source confirmed a specific SKU in this research session, so makes_plates is left unset rather than asserted. No evidence UltiMaker white-labels for others or resells another manufacturer's filament under its own name. Pricing sits above hobbyist commodity brands, reflecting a verified-material ecosystem; no $/kg figure was confirmed.

provenance.conflicts: manufacturing_countries lists all three UltiMaker sites, but only printer-hardware production is sourced to them — filament-specific extrusion locations were not itemised, so the Netherlands entry is solid and the US/Singapore entries are inferred. Build-plate sales are likely but unconfirmed, so makes_plates is unset. Reddit/Discord/TikTok presence not confirmed.
